describe.description: The creature is a quadrupedal, bear-like mammal shown in right-facing profile standing on a plain light background. Its entire body except for several glossy dark areas is covered in long, shaggy brown fur that is lighter tan on the muzzle, lower jaw and chest and darker brown on the lower legs. The head, ears, legs, paws and short stub tail are mammalian and bear-like, while the back, shoulders and outer forearms bear large, smooth, highly glossy dark reddish-brown to black exoskeletal structures resembling a beetle, and a single large curved horn projects from the center of the forehead.

describe.description: A large four-legged creature with the dense shaggy brown fur, head, ears, legs, paws and short stub tail of a brown bear, combined with beetle features. A long glossy dark curved horn with a single tine rises from the center of its forehead. Two large glossy dark reddish-brown beetle shell plates sit on its back, one over the shoulders behind the neck and one over the rear back, with a row of small round dark breathing holes in the fur along the side under the rear plate. Segmented glossy dark chitinous plates also cover the front of the upper front legs.
